description: Calibrate the TZF RNA-contact identity metric against paralog pairs of known specificity relationship, and test whether MEX-5/MEX-6 identity at RNA-contacting positions is enriched over background sequence conservation
code:
# ============================================================================
# Iteration 2, analysis 1
# Question: is "27 of 30 RNA-contacting positions identical" actually
# informative, or is it just what two highly similar paralogs look like
# everywhere in their sequence?
#
# Two controls:
#   (A) Calibration. Apply the identical anchor-relative mapping to TZF pairs
#       whose specificity relationship is independently known from the
#       literature, and see where MEX-5/MEX-6 falls on that scale.
#   (B) Enrichment. Within the MEX-5/MEX-6 TZF block (which is ungapped-
#       alignable because the two proteins have identical finger spacing),
#       compare identity at the 30 RNA-contacting positions with identity at
#       the 42 non-contacting positions of the same block, and with identity
#       over the whole protein. Fisher exact test.
# ============================================================================
import collections, re, json
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, requests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact

AA3TO1 = {"ALA":"A","ARG":"R","ASN":"N","ASP":"D","CYS":"C","GLN":"Q","GLU":"E","GLY":"G",
          "HIS":"H","ILE":"I","LEU":"L","LYS":"K","MET":"M","PHE":"F","PRO":"P","SER":"S",
          "THR":"T","TRP":"W","TYR":"Y","VAL":"V"}
RNA_BACKBONE = {"P","OP1","OP2","O5'","C5'","C4'","O4'","C3'","O3'","C2'","O2'","C1'"}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 1RGO ensemble
txt = requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1RGO.pdb", timeout=120).text
models = collections.defaultdict(list); cur = None
for line in txt.split("\n"):
    if line.startswith("MODEL"): cur = int(line.split()[1])
    elif line.startswith("ENDMDL"): cur = None
    elif cur and line.startswith("ATOM"):
        el = (line[76:78].strip() or line[12:16].strip()[0])
        if el == "H": continue
        models[cur].append((line[21], int(line[22:26]), line[17:20].strip(), line[12:16].strip(),
                            float(line[30:38]), float(line[38:46]), float(line[46:54])))
n_models = len(models)

# per-residue contact frequency over the 20 NMR models, 4.0 A heavy-atom cutoff
any_c, base_c, mind = collections.Counter(), collections.Counter(), {}
for atoms in models.values():
    prot = [a for a in atoms if a[0] == "A"]; rna = [a for a in atoms if a[0] == "D"]
    D = np.linalg.norm(np.array([a[4:7] for a in prot])[:,None] - np.array([a[4:7] for a in rna])[None], axis=2)
    sa, sb = set(), set()
    for i, j in zip(*np.where(D < 4.0)):
        sa.add(prot[i][1])
        if rna[j][3] not in RNA_BACKBONE: sb.add(prot[i][1])
    for r in sa: any_c[r] += 1
    for r in sb: base_c[r] += 1
    for i in range(len(prot)):
        r = prot[i][1]; m = D[i].min()
        mind[r] = min(mind.get(r, 99.0), m)

# --------------------------------------------------- anchor-relative template
OFFSETS = [("C1",-6),("C1",-4),("C1",-3),("C1",-2),("C1",-1),("C1",0),("C1",1),("C1",2),
           ("C2",0),("C2",1),("C2",2),("C3",-1),("C3",0),("C3",1),("C3",2)]
AI = {"C1":0,"C2":1,"C3":2,"H":3}
T_ZF1 = {("C1",-6):153,("C1",-4):155,("C1",-3):156,("C1",-2):157,("C1",-1):158,("C1",0):159,
         ("C1",1):160,("C1",2):161,("C2",0):168,("C2",1):169,("C2",2):170,("C3",-1):173,
         ("C3",0):174,("C3",1):175,("C3",2):176}
ROLE = {("C1",-6):"bb/base 5'U",("C1",-4):"base U",("C1",-3):"base U",("C1",-2):"discriminator",
        ("C1",-1):"base A",("C1",0):"Zn",("C1",1):"base A",("C1",2):"base A/U",("C2",0):"Zn",
        ("C2",1):"base U",("C2",2):"stacking",("C3",-1):"contact",("C3",0):"Zn",("C3",1):"base",
        ("C3",2):"stacking"}

# --------------------------------------------------------------- sequences
ACC = {
 # human TZF paralog trio: all three bind the same AU-rich element (shared specificity)
 "TTP_Hs":"P26651", "TIS11b_Hs":"Q07352", "TIS11d_Hs":"P47974",
 # mouse TTP, an ortholog control (identical specificity by definition)
 "TTP_Mm":"P22893",
 # C. elegans TZF proteins
 "MEX5_Ce":"Q9XUB2", "MEX6_Ce":"Q09436", "POS1_Ce":"G5EF15",
 "MEX1_Ce":"Q7JM77", "OMA1_Ce":"G5EC86",
}
# OMA-2 accession resolved from UniProt rather than guessed
r = requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
                 params={"query":"gene:oma-2 AND organism_id:6239 AND reviewed:false",
                         "fields":"accession,gene_names,protein_name,length","format":"json","size":"5"},
                 timeout=60).json()
print("OMA-2 UniProt hits:", [(x["primaryAccession"], x.get("sequence",{}).get("length")) for x in r["results"]])
if r["results"]:
    ACC["OMA2_Ce"] = r["results"][0]["primaryAccession"]

SEQ = {}
for k, a in ACC.items():
    f = requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta", timeout=60).text
    SEQ[k] = "".join(f.split("\n")[1:])
    assert len(SEQ[k]) > 50, (k, a)
print({k: len(v) for k, v in SEQ.items()})

ZF_RE = re.compile(r"(?=(C.{7,12}C.{4,6}C.{2,4}H))")
def find_fingers(seq):
    out = {}
    for m in ZF_RE.finditer(seq):
        inner = re.match(r"C(.{7,12}?)C(.{4,6}?)C(.{2,4}?)H$", m.group(1))
        if not inner: continue
        s = m.start() + 1
        l1, l2, l3 = (len(g) for g in inner.groups())
        out.setdefault(s, (s, s+1+l1, s+2+l1+l2, s+3+l1+l2+l3, f"CX{l1}CX{l2}CX{l3}H"))
    return sorted(out.values())

ANCH = {k: find_fingers(s) for k, s in SEQ.items()}
for k in ACC:
    a = ANCH[k][:2]
    print(f"{k:11s} {ACC[k]:12s} fingers {[(f[0], f[4]) for f in a]} linker {a[1][0]-a[0][3]-1}")

# ------------------------------------------------- read off contacting residues
labels, cols = [], {k: [] for k in ACC}
for fi in (0, 1):
    for off in OFFSETS:
        t = T_ZF1[off] + 38*fi
        labels.append((f"ZF{fi+1}", f"{off[0]}{off[1]:+d}", t, ROLE[off],
                       base_c[t]/n_models, any_c[t]/n_models, round(mind.get(t, np.nan), 2)))
        for k in ACC:
            cols[k].append(SEQ[k][ANCH[k][fi][AI[off[0]]] + off[1] - 1])
tab = pd.concat([pd.DataFrame(labels, columns=["finger","pos","TIS11d_num","role",
                                               "base_contact_freq","any_contact_freq","min_dist_A"]),
                 pd.DataFrame(cols)], axis=1)
tab.to_csv("tzf_contact_positions_calibration.csv", index=False)
print("\n", tab[["finger","pos","TIS11d_num","role","base_contact_freq","any_contact_freq",
                 "TTP_Hs","TIS11d_Hs","MEX5_Ce","MEX6_Ce","POS1_Ce","OMA1_Ce"]].to_string(index=False))

# ------------------------------------------------------------ (A) calibration
PAIRS = [("TTP_Hs","TIS11d_Hs","same ARE specificity (human paralogs)"),
         ("TTP_Hs","TIS11b_Hs","same ARE specificity (human paralogs)"),
         ("TIS11b_Hs","TIS11d_Hs","same ARE specificity (human paralogs)"),
         ("TTP_Hs","TTP_Mm","same specificity (orthologs)"),
         ("MEX5_Ce","MEX6_Ce","specificity relationship under test"),
         ("OMA1_Ce","OMA2_Ce","redundant C. elegans paralog pair"),
         ("MEX5_Ce","POS1_Ce","different element (PMID 18952820)"),
         ("MEX5_Ce","TTP_Hs","different element (PMID 17264081)"),
         ("MEX5_Ce","MEX1_Ce","different protein, specificity unmeasured"),
         ("POS1_Ce","MEX1_Ce","different protein, specificity unmeasured")]
rows = []
for a, b, note in PAIRS:
    if b not in ACC: continue
    ident = int((tab[a] == tab[b]).sum())
    disc = [(tab["finger"][i], tab[a][i], tab[b][i]) for i in range(len(tab))
            if tab["pos"][i] == "C1-2"]
    rows.append({"pair": f"{a} vs {b}", "identity_30": ident, "pct": 100*ident/30,
                 "discriminators": " / ".join(f"{f}:{x}{'=' if x==y else '!'}{y}" for f, x, y in disc),
                 "known_relationship": note})
cal = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("identity_30", ascending=False)
cal.to_csv("tzf_pair_calibration.csv", index=False)
print("\n=== (A) identity at the 30 RNA-contacting positions ===")
print(cal.to_string(index=False))

# ---------------------------------------- (B) enrichment within the TZF block
# MEX-6 anchors are uniformly MEX-5 + 3, so the TZF block aligns without gaps.
off5 = ANCH["MEX5_Ce"]; off6 = ANCH["MEX6_Ce"]
shift = off6[0][0] - off5[0][0]
assert all(off6[f][i] - off5[f][i] == shift for f in (0, 1) for i in range(4)), "block not ungapped"
start5, end5 = off5[0][0] - 6, off5[1][3]          # C1(ZF1)-6 .. H(ZF2)
blk5 = SEQ["MEX5_Ce"][start5-1:end5]
blk6 = SEQ["MEX6_Ce"][start5-1+shift:end5+shift]
contact_idx = sorted({ANCH["MEX5_Ce"][fi][AI[o[0]]] + o[1] - start5 for fi in (0,1) for o in OFFSETS})
print(f"\nTZF block MEX-5 {start5}-{end5} (len {len(blk5)}), MEX-6 {start5+shift}-{end5+shift}")

con_id = sum(blk5[i] == blk6[i] for i in contact_idx); con_n = len(contact_idx)
non_idx = [i for i in range(len(blk5)) if i not in set(contact_idx)]
non_id = sum(blk5[i] == blk6[i] for i in non_idx); non_n = len(non_idx)

# whole-protein identity by Needleman-Wunsch (match +1, mismatch -1, gap -2)
def nw_identity(s, t, match=1, mismatch=-1, gap=-2):
    n, m = len(s), len(t)
    S = np.zeros((n+1, m+1)); S[0,:] = np.arange(m+1)*gap; S[:,0] = np.arange(n+1)*gap
    P = np.zeros((n+1, m+1), dtype=np.int8); P[0,1:] = 2; P[1:,0] = 1
    sa = np.frombuffer(s.encode(), dtype=np.uint8); ta = np.frombuffer(t.encode(), dtype=np.uint8)
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        diag = S[i-1,:-1] + np.where(sa[i-1] == ta, match, mismatch)
        up = S[i-1,1:] + gap
        best = np.maximum(diag, up); S[i,1:] = best; P[i,1:] = np.where(diag >= up, 0, 1)
        for j in range(1, m+1):                      # left dependency, sequential
            if S[i,j-1] + gap > S[i,j]: S[i,j] = S[i,j-1] + gap; P[i,j] = 2
    i, j, idn, aln = n, m, 0, 0
    while i > 0 or j > 0:
        p = P[i,j]
        if p == 0: idn += (s[i-1] == t[j-1]); aln += 1; i -= 1; j -= 1
        elif p == 1: aln += 1; i -= 1
        else: aln += 1; j -= 1
    return idn, aln

wid, waln = nw_identity(SEQ["MEX5_Ce"], SEQ["MEX6_Ce"])
odds, p = fisher_exact([[con_id, con_n-con_id], [non_id, non_n-non_id]])
print(f"\n=== (B) MEX-5 vs MEX-6 identity, nested windows ===")
print(f"  whole protein (NW global)        {wid}/{waln} = {100*wid/waln:.1f}%")
print(f"  TZF block (72 aa, ungapped)      {con_id+non_id}/{len(blk5)} = {100*(con_id+non_id)/len(blk5):.1f}%")
print(f"  RNA-contacting positions         {con_id}/{con_n} = {100*con_id/con_n:.1f}%")
print(f"  non-contacting TZF positions     {non_id}/{non_n} = {100*non_id/non_n:.1f}%")
print(f"  Fisher exact contacting vs non-contacting: OR={odds:.2f}, p={p:.3f}")

# same contrast against POS-1 cannot use an ungapped block, so report block identity only
pd.DataFrame([{"window":"whole protein","identical":wid,"total":waln},
              {"window":"TZF block","identical":con_id+non_id,"total":len(blk5)},
              {"window":"RNA-contacting","identical":con_id,"total":con_n},
              {"window":"TZF non-contacting","identical":non_id,"total":non_n}]
             ).to_csv("mex5_mex6_nested_identity.csv", index=False)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------- figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5.2))
x = np.arange(len(tab)); lab = [f"{f} {p}" for f, p in zip(tab["finger"], tab["pos"])]
ax[0].bar(x, tab["any_contact_freq"], color="#c9d6e8", label="any RNA atom")
ax[0].bar(x, tab["base_contact_freq"], color="#2b5d8c", label="RNA base atom")
diff = [i for i in range(len(tab)) if tab["MEX5_Ce"][i] != tab["MEX6_Ce"][i]]
for i in diff:
    ax[0].annotate(f"{tab['MEX5_Ce'][i]}/{tab['MEX6_Ce'][i]}", (i, tab["any_contact_freq"][i]+0.04),
                   ha="center", fontsize=8, color="#b03030", fontweight="bold")
for i in [j for j in range(len(tab)) if tab["pos"][j] == "C1-2"]:
    ax[0].annotate("disc.", (i, 1.06), ha="center", fontsize=8, color="#1a7f37")
ax[0].set_xticks(x); ax[0].set_xticklabels(lab, rotation=90, fontsize=7)
ax[0].set_ylabel("fraction of the 20 NMR models with a contact")
ax[0].set_title("TIS11d contacts to UUAUUUAUU (PDB 1RGO, 4 A cutoff)\nred: MEX-5/MEX-6 difference, green: discriminator")
ax[0].set_ylim(0, 1.18); ax[0].legend(fontsize=8, loc="lower right")

col = {"specificity relationship under test":"#b03030"}
c2 = [col.get(n, "#7a9cc6" if "same" in n or "redundant" in n else "#9a9a9a") for n in cal["known_relationship"]]
ax[1].barh(range(len(cal)), cal["identity_30"], color=c2)
ax[1].set_yticks(range(len(cal))); ax[1].set_yticklabels(cal["pair"], fontsize=8)
ax[1].invert_yaxis(); ax[1].set_xlabel("identical residues at the 30 RNA-contacting positions")
ax[1].set_xlim(0, 31); ax[1].axvline(30, ls=":", c="k", lw=0.8)
for i, v in enumerate(cal["identity_30"]): ax[1].text(v+0.3, i, str(v), va="center", fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_title("Calibration: blue = pairs with the same known specificity,\ngrey = pairs with different or unmeasured specificity, red = MEX-5/MEX-6")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
